race.comment: MAJOR SHIRAZ (2) flew the lids off the inside draw with a fast early split and gave a sight, finishing a 1.5 lengths second (25.61) over 450m at this track. Can measure up this time. POWER AFFECT (3) has been settling off the speed lately, finishing sixth (22.79) last time in a Grade 5 at this track. Form here sound including two wins. Has ability and a bold showing is expected. HARTLAND ROCKET (1) wasn't far away at the finish when 4th and beaten only 2.75 lengths (24.25) at Bendigo. Cannot be left out. MAGIC BULLSEYE (7) is worth including.
